- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Per the workspace-source-manifest convention in `scripts/workspace_init.sh::materialize_source_tree` and the prior precedent set by this very PR (which adds `changelog.d/4338-review-editor-sandbox-init.md` on the same hunk), every AI PR that adds a `changelog.d/<n>-<slug>.md` fragment must also append that path to `.ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt` so future materializations track the new file and the deterministic union-merge in `scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh` keeps both sides' additions.
  Expected change site: `.ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt` near line 227 (between `changelog.d/4379-followup-metadata-and-merged-label-race.md` and `changelog.d/changelog-fragment-workflow.md`, where the new `changelog.d/4392-workspace-guard-git-context.md` belongs in the existing sorted order).
  Evidence of absence: The new fragment `changelog.d/4392-workspace-guard-git-context.md` is created by the PR (per the `+++ b/changelog.d/4392-workspace-guard-git-context.md` hunk in the diff) but no `+changelog.d/4392-workspace-guard-git-context.md` line is added to `.ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt`. The PR instead adds only `changelog.d/4338-review-editor-sandbox-init.md` (which is an unrelated fragment from PR #4338), so the manifest gains a stray entry while missing the entry that corresponds to the PR's own changelog claim. Without the manifest entry, the file is still copied by the `os.walk(source)` step in `scripts/workspace_init.sh:301`, but it is not in `previous_set` and so on the next materialize-prune cycle (`scripts/workspace_init.sh:339-358`) the workspace may keep a stale copy after the fragment is consumed by `scripts/assemble_changelog.py` — exactly the kind of leftover-state inconsistency the manifest is meant to prevent. The contract test `tests/test_conflict_manifest_union_contract.py` does not catch this omission (it covers the union-merge logic, not completeness), so the gap would persist undetected.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
